newsitem.title: UK: Amstrad's Dancall to launch new mobile phone.
newsitem.headline: Amstrad's Dancall to launch new mobile phone.

text.p: Dancall, the Danish mobile cellular phone firm, will soon launch a new cellular phone which can be used to make and receive calls in all continents without making any technical changes.
The phone, named Dancall World phone, would be available to consumers by the end of this year, Alan Sugar, chairman of Amstrad Plc, Dancall's parent, told a news conference.
Subscribers to the new phone would be able to retain their original phone number irrespective of where they are using the phone.

"Not only does it mark a major technological advance, but, more inmportantly, it opens the era when mobile users can travel worldwide and be in touch whenever they are in Europe, Middle East, Australasia, Asia and other GSM territories," Sugar said.
Dancall is due to launch another model, Dancall Roamer, which will use both GSM 900 and PCN 1800 technologies.
This model is seen helping PCN operators like Orange in the UK, E-Plus in Germany and Bouygues in France to offer international service on GSM phones.
The Roamer is seen hitting the market around October.
The prices of the models have not yet been fixed.
